time_contract.demo_clock_warning: Native demo shows two synthetic protected-hit instants 1.29s and 3.12s only. Cast illustration bursts from 0 to 0.78, visible shield status is subdued 0.45..4.45, and residual fade 4.45..4.84. No live HP/status/guard application or outgoing attack.
time_contract.key_pose_budget_note: Eight cast frames for brief guardian bloom/retract, eight genuinely varying status frames for the long loop, eight original-art contact frames triggered on hit. Still-loop frame count is independent of 4-second buff duration.

moving_target.tracking_rule: Protected disciple uses the original WALK sprite atlas while moving. Both quiet buff and shield-contact image follow the same moving recipient; opponent also walks. No enemy HP changes; block is explicitly demo-only.

proof_contract.source: FIST07 contract protects 4s guard, distinct cast/status clocks, approved unchanged WALK sprites on recipient, localized visual block on moving recipient, and forbidden damage/status mutations. All hit times LAB-simulated.
